titolo: datasette-llm 0.1a9 adds default LLM model support
descr: The new pre‑release lets the plugin automatically use the default LLM model, simplifying Datasette Agent setup.
paragrafi: On 31 October 2026 Simon Willison announced the 0.1a9 pre‑release of the datasette-llm plugin.
The update makes the plugin pick up the default model used by LLM, removing the need to set a model explicitly for Datasette Agent.
Previously users had to add a command‑line flag such as -s plugins.datasette-agent.default_model gpt-6-astra.
The release is listed on GitHub as a pre‑release with commit 9db9d61, signed with a verified GPG key.
perche: Users seeking free or locally hosted models benefit from a smoother integration workflow.
